title: Lightning Agents: A Registry Pattern for Claude Agent SDK Agents
summary: Riccardo Pirruccio presents Lightning Agents, a plugin and registry pattern on the Claude Agent SDK that lets agents create new agents.

chapters.title: Q&A on the Factory of Factories

learn: Pirruccio says building agents has been an empirical, step-by-step process, and chains of callables in the early LangChain style leave code and prompts everywhere that do not scale.
The proposal is a plugin system with a registry, built on the Claude Agent SDK, so agent configurations persist in a database instead of being defined in a file each time.
Pirruccio traces the idea to Voyager, a 2023 NVIDIA paper in which a GPT-4 model plays Minecraft and adds learned skills to a skills registry to progress.
The demo shows an agents.json configuration added to the registry and called through a registry function, so the agent becomes available as a runnable.
Agents get CRUD tools for the agent and tool registries, and an architect agent and a tools architect agent generate new ones through a CLI.
Pirruccio says agent design is shifting from edge cases to environment boundary conditions and guardrails, and uses a plain logger instead of an OpenTelemetry setup.
